CATEGORY_INBOX_OVERVIEW.TITLE: Categories & Inboxes
CATEGORY_INBOX_OVERVIEW.DESCRIPTION: A read-only overview of your categories (teams), their WhatsApp inboxes, staff, and setup status. Use the deep-links to make changes in the existing Team and Inbox editors.
CATEGORY_INBOX_OVERVIEW.EMPTY: No categories or inboxes to show yet.
CATEGORY_INBOX_OVERVIEW.ERROR: We couldn't load the categories and inboxes overview. Please try again.

CATEGORY.NO_INBOX: No WhatsApp inbox is derived for this category yet.

DRIFT.STAFF_MISSING: {count} team member without inbox access | {count} team member without inbox access | {count} team members without inbox access
DRIFT.COLLABORATORS_EXTRA: {count} inbox collaborator not on the team | {count} inbox collaborator not on the team | {count} inbox collaborators not on the team

AMBIGUOUS.TITLE: Ambiguous inboxes
AMBIGUOUS.DESCRIPTION: These inboxes share members with more than one category, so the overview will not guess a single category. Review the overlapping teams before making changes.

UNLINKED.TITLE: Unlinked inboxes
UNLINKED.DESCRIPTION: These inboxes share no members with any category, so they can't be derived into one. Assign shared members in the inbox editor to link them.
